entries: The {rival} had planted {the_thing:!living} {HIDING} to point at {CLOSE:human}, out of {MOTIVE}.
{the_someone:human} staged the whole thing {MANNER}, out of {MOTIVE}.
{the_message:physical} was forged by {CLOSE:human}, who feared {TOPIC} most.
The clock at {landmark:built} was wrong, and {the_someone:human} had set it back {MANNER}.
Two people committed {the_disaster:manmade}, and {first} had trusted both.
{the_thing:portable} was the clue all along, sitting {HIDING} since the first day.
The {rival} solved {TOPIC} first, and kept quiet out of {MOTIVE}.
The victim was alive: {the_someone:human} had hidden {MANNER} in {place} all along.
Every alibi held but one: {the_someone:human} lied about {landmark}.
The guilty one was {the_someone:human}, who had helped {first} search {MANNER}.
{the_disaster:manmade} hid an older crime at {landmark}, and the {rival} had known.
Nobody stole {the_thing:valuable}; {CLOSE:human} had sold it {MANNER} to pay for {TOPIC}.
